message: Partial refunds now come out right. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by `percent`, which is 0–100, so a 50% refund came back 50 times too large. It now divides by 100, so 50% of 1250 gives 625. `npm test` passes with all 20 tests, including the partial-refund ones. I changed nothing outside `src/payments`.
